title: About the Author
text: ABOUT THE AUTHOR TJ KLUNE is the New York Times and USA Today bestselling, Lambda Literary Award–winning author of The House in the Cerulean Sea, The Extraordinaries, and more. Being queer himself, TJ believes it’s important—now more than ever—to have accurate, positive queer representation in stories. Visit Klune online: tjklunebooks.com, or sign up for email updates here . Twitter: @tjklune Instagram: tjklunebooks
